welcomeAndCast.welcome: Optional three-step cast, practice hold and party ticket introduction. Skip, close or Escape persists local dismissal; footer How it works reopens it. Add my crew selects Imposter and opens Crew. No redundant kicker labels.
welcomeAndCast.practice: Illustrative PINEAPPLE word only; hold/release with pointer or Space/Enter; immediate concealment on cancellation, lost capture, blur, visibility or step changes.
welcomeAndCast.castTickets: Five alternating fills; charcoal text and bold contrasting reorder/sign-out controls. Scores use shared competition ranks for ties.
welcomeAndCast.radiusUsage: Existing card 16px for welcome/panels; phone-card 14px for practice, score rows and pack navigation; play 10px for pack/action buttons; stepper 8px for points; progress 2px for step bars.
welcomeAndCast.welcomeLayout: 480px maximum width; calc(100dvh - 32px) maximum height; scrollable; 24px padding, 18px below 370px.

secretGeometry.overflow: Scrollable absolute inset content; fixed outer window with overflow-anchor: none.

controlsAndReveal.privacy: Private role, word, hint and decoy are conditionally mounted only while held; concealment unmounts them immediately. Active hold transforms are disabled. Existing three-second guard and pointer/keyboard/focus-loss protections remain.

readyLayout.tallAlignment: Top-aligned columns with natural cast height; launch margin-top: auto anchors it independently at stage bottom.

controls.keyboard: ArrowRight correct, ArrowLeft skip, Escape pause; repeat/modifier/composition, text-field and modal events cannot score.
controls.tilt: Explicit opt-in; floor correct, ceiling skip, upright between gestures; score-free ready practice. Missing data after five seconds provides fallback text.

validation.reported: All 24 unit tests and 23 browser tests passed before the final compact ready-layout adjustment. The final compact layout subsequently received a scoped visual-review disposition of ship.
validation.limits: Source-only documentation pass; physical-phone sensor behavior remains unverified.

partyAudioAndReach.revealCue: Stable instruction above the held button, outside fingertip area; button label stays Hold to peek.
partyAudioAndReach.mobile: Lower action grouping for portrait reveal, Heads Up and discussion; natural scrolling on short viewports.
partyAudioAndReach.narration: Only the two bundled VoiceStudio hosts are selectable. Original clip speed preserves phrasing; legacy device selections use storyteller. No browser TTS fallback. Preview/stop controls and immediate cancellation; no private roles or words spoken.
partyAudioAndReach.countdown: Optional sound follows master volume/sound and changes at 60, 30 and 10 seconds. Numeric timer remains authoritative.
partyAudioAndReach.vocabulary: Expanded finite offline library with Celebrities; unseen first then recycled. Append unique batches and save more packs; no unlimited free AI claim.

fasterParty.hint: Bold familiar one-word association plus category in the existing private hint inset; category-only harder option. No delay on concealment.
fasterParty.voting: Quick group point-vote default for future rounds; optional secret mode; sealed public envelope can be swiped up or opened with a native button, no timed gate.
fasterParty.motion: Cards and geometric game emblems enter once on viewport intersection. Three-identity Imposter stack; 220ms envelope lift and 250ms verdict copy. Reduced motion removes these effects.
fasterParty.charades: Classic actor mode uses coral shell and full-width lavender actor stage. Prompt appears only during protected hold; acting screen has no secret. Timed handoffs pause; no-timer option available. Four-player minimum for classic teams.

narrative.overview:
A mature, playful party identity built from lime and charcoal, five distinct game worlds, compact typography and confident controls. The inline hudl n game wordmark uses a tilted lime lowercase n card; a three-character cast drawn from the actual Identity component connects the default home and player roster, while individual game emblems distinguish the five choices. Cards feel like a deck shared around a table; private role information has immediate, unmistakable hierarchy.

Social Club is the default masked identity edition. Settings > Design > Social Club original restores the previous Social Club home and logo; Classic restores the original home, logo, Fredoka/Nunito typography and sticker-book styling. The original specification is preserved in [the Classic design archive](docs/design-archive/classic/DESIGN.md). The user-authorized replacement is recorded in [the surface brief](docs/surface.md) and current PRODUCT.md brand commitments; the underlying five-game product, player names and twenty stored avatar identifiers remain. The default edition renders those identifiers as deterministic masked SVG identities; the original editions retain their prior presentation.
keyCharacteristics: Lime lobby actions, charcoal typography and five game-specific palettes and surface forms.
Self-hosted Space Grotesk throughout the default design.
Compact phone layouts, generous touch controls and a persistent lobby navigation.
Flat controls with limited depth on decorative cards and dialogs.
Twenty stable identities mapped to ten silhouettes and faces, with alternate cheek/accessory treatments and six colours; finite entry motion without replay controls.
Reversible Social Club original and Classic variants, plus immediate hold-to-reveal privacy.

rules.name: The Paired Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep player names and game names alongside colours and icons; colour alone must not communicate identity.

rules.name: The Immediate Privacy Rule
rules.body: Reveal the role or word only while held after the three-second handoff guard. Hide on release, cancellation, lost pointer capture, blur, visibility change or handoff. Never delay concealment for motion or automatically narrate a secret. Space and Enter provide hold/release access; private content uses `aria-live="off"`.

rules.name: The Stable Hold Rule
rules.body: Keep the private window and hold control in the same position when hidden content is replaced by a role, word or hint. The hold button has no active transform. Longer content scrolls inside the fixed window rather than pushing the control away.

dos: **Do** use the Social Club tokens for new default screens and preserve both original design choices.
**Do** retain readable labels, native checked states and visible keyboard focus.
**Do** show draft provenance and keep review, manual editing and saving distinct.
**Do** let phone play fill the viewport while allowing content to scroll.
**Do** keep secret visibility transient and concealment immediate.
**Do** retain player names and stable avatar identifiers; use the masked identity artwork in the default edition.
**Do** keep the reveal window and held target stable while content changes.
**Do** offer touch and keyboard play alongside optional tilt and score-free practice.
donts: **Don't** bring the Classic mascot or sticker-book shadows back into the Social Club home.
**Don't** overwrite the archived Classic design or remove its self-hosted fonts.
**Don't** put the lobby navigation over an active game.
**Don't** claim complete functional or accessibility validation from a scoped visual review.
**Don't** make AI generation automatic or required for pack creation.
